svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner
svg.desc: Concept 09 Exposure Sheets landing page: the planning copy laid over the import like a sheet on a light table.
svg.text: Smart Warehouse Planner reads the three files your warehouse
already exports and recommends which parts to move where, each
with its rule and its numbers. You try the moves on a planning copy,
compare before and after, and print the move list. The tool suggests;
Demo runs on synthetic data · data as of 2026-09-30 · no account, no network calls
The planning copy lies over the import. Slide it aside to see what was there;
magenta marks only where they differ. The import itself never changes.
One plan, six steps, in this order
Explain every number · honest about the data · paper is a first-class output

g.text: Run in rounds, rule by rule
Round order, a tick box per line
